content: Dawiti ceeggida wode ba naa Solomoone Isra7eele bolla kawoththides.
Leweta Ooso
Dawiti Isra7eele kaaleththiza ubbata, qeesetanne Leweta issife shiishshides.
Isttas layththay heedzdzu tammanne hessafekka bollara gidida attuma asata Lewetappe qoodides; istta qooday kumeth 38,000 gidides.
Haytanttafe 24,000 Xoossaa Keeththa ooso kaaletti xeellana mala aawateth isttas immides; qasse 6,000 asatas shuumetanne pirda daannata histti woththides.
Oyddu shiyatas gimbeza penge naagana mala aawateth immides; attida oyddu shiyatas ba ooththida yeththa massaratan GODAA Xoossa galatana mala sunththides.
Dawiti Lewey yelida attuma nayta Gershoone, Qa7aatenne Meraare istta zarkken zarkken heedzdzu kessi shaakkides.
Gershooney yelida attuma nayti Laadaanenne Shim7e.
Laadaane attuma nayti heedzdza; isttika Yihi7eele, Zettaamenne Iyu7eele.
Shim7e attuma nayti heedzdza; isttika Shalomite, Hazi7eelenne Haaraane; heyti Laadaane zarkketas halaqata.
Shim7e attuma nayti, Yahaate, Ziina, Ya7uushenne Barihe.
Bayrazi Yahaate, kaalozi Ziina; Ya7uushessinne Barihes daro attuma nayti baynda gishshas issi keeththa asa mala qoodettida.
Qa7aates oyddu attuma nayti deettes; heytikka Amiraame, Yixihaare, Kebroonenne Uzi7eele.

Amiraame attuma nayti Aaroonenne Muse; Aarooneynne iza zereththati Xoossa Keeththan go7ettiza miishshata mernaas dummasana mala, Xoossas yarsho shiishshana mala, Xoossa sinththan haggazana malanne iza sunththan deraa mernaas anjjana mala dummatida.
Xoossa as Muse attuma naytikka Lewe qommota mala qoodettida.
Muse nayti Gershoomenne El7ezeere.
Gershoome naytas halaqay bayra naaza Shuba7eele.
El7ezeeres issi attuma nay xalla dees; izikka Erahaabiya; Erahaabiyas gidikko daro attuma nayti deettes.
Yixihaare naytas halaqay bayra naaza Shalomite.
Kebroone naytappe bayrazi Yiriya, nam7anththozi Amaariya, heedzdzanththozi Yahazi7eele, oydanththozi Yoqima7aame.
Uzi7eele attuma naytappe bayrazi Mikiyaasa, kaalozi Yishiya.
Meraare attuma nayti Mahilenne Mushe; Mahile attuma nayti El7ezeerenne Qiise.
El7ezeerey macca naa xalla yelidi attuma naa yelontta hayqqides; hessa gishshas istti bantta aawa isha Qiise nayta gelida.
Mushe attuma nayti heedzdza; heytikka Mahile, Edeerenne Yarmoote.
Haytanti ubbay baso asataninne ba zarkketan xeygettida; Lewe zareti issoy issoy ba sunththan mazgabettida; isttas layththay nam7u tammanne hessafe bolla gididayti Xoossa Keeththan ooththeettes.
Dawiti, «Isra7eele Godaa Xoossi ba asaa shempisides; Yerusalaamen mernaas de7ana.
Hayssafe guye Leweti Dunkaanezanne iza giddon go7ettiza miishshata tookkanaas bessenna» gides.
Dawiti wurseththan immida azazo mala isttas layththay nam7u tammanne hessafe bollara gidida Leweti qoodettida.

Leweta oosoy Xoossa Keeththan Aaroone zereththata ooson ooththi maado, Xoossa Keeththa giddozanne gibbeza lo7eththi naago, Xoossa Keeththa oosos dummatida miishshata lo7eththi oyththinne Xoossa Keeththan diza hara oosotakka lo7eththi ooso.

Qasseka Xoossa sinththan woththiza ukeththas, kaththa yarshos shiishshiza dhiilles, munuqanaas, irshoy baynda uukettiza uketh uukkanaas, makkizaazassinne meezaanizaazas alaafeteththi isttas imettides.
Hessaththoka istti ubbaa gallas maaladonne omars Godaa Xoossa sinththan eqqidi galatanaasinne bonchchanaas,
sambata gallas, aginay doommiza koyro gallassatan, ba7aale gallassatan wogaa qooda mala Godaa Xoossa sinththan ubba wode xuugetti shiiqiza yarsho shiishshanaas,
Gaytoteththa Dunkaanenne Xoossa Keeth naaganaas, iza giddon oosettiza goyno wogata polishin ba dabbo Aaroone zereththata maaddanaas aawateththi imettides.
